seed: The red dashed refusal outline around the whole right panel used to turn up for drags that had nothing to do with files - a colour off a swatch, a layer row being carried - and once it was up it never cleared. This walk holds a file the app cannot use over a layer row (the mark is right there), lets it go (the mark goes), holds a picture (the accepting mark and the drop line), abandons a file drag in the air without a word (the mark has to take itself off), then carries the app's own things over the same row and expects the panel to say nothing at all.

steps.note: a real file the app cannot place, held over a layer row: this is the refusal mark, and it is the only drag it is there to answer
a picture over the same row: the accepting mark and the drop line that says where it lands

THE STUCK CASE: a drag armed and then abandoned without a word, which is what escape, a release outside the window and a row rebuilt under the pointer all look like from inside. The mark has to take itself off.
a colour off the Fill swatch carried up over a layer row: the panel must say NOTHING about it
a layer row being carried over another row: the panel must say NOTHING about it either
and a file arriving after a row drag that never ended: the file still gets the file answer rather than being read as that row coming back
nothing is in the air and nothing is marked
